notes: Maui Land & Pineapple Co (NYSE: MLP) — Hawaiian land owner / diversified land company (CIK 63330). Owns ~22,000 acres on Maui (predominantly West Maui — Kapalua Resort area + Upcountry). Exited active pineapple operations 2009; today operates land leases (commercial, residential, agricultural), Kapalua resort amenities (Plantation/Bay golf courses, Kapalua Spa), small water/utility business, and selective land development. Fiscal year = calendar. Sub-$10M revenue; book value heavily understated relative to market value of land. Largely uses historical-cost basis for land (acquired pre-1909).

periods.notes: FY20: revenue $7.4M. EBITDA $-3.5M (pandemic Kapalua resort hit). Net loss $4.5M. ~22,300 acres carried at $5.6M historical cost.
FY21: revenue $11.1M (+50%). EBITDA $1.3M (lot sales boost). Net income $0.5M (returned to profit).
FY22: revenue $9.2M. EBITDA $-2.4M. Net loss $3.5M. Slower lot sales.
FY23: revenue $8.5M. EBITDA $-3.0M. Net loss $4.0M. Aug 2023 Lahaina/West Maui wildfires impacted Kapalua-area operations.
FY24: revenue $12.5M (+47%). EBITDA $1.0M. Net income $0.2M. Lot sales rebounded. Pursuing entitlements on ~1,500 acres for residential/workforce housing.
